title: 2021 Panini Contenders DP #17 Teddy Bridgewater Louisville Cardinals
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021 Panini Contenders Draft Picks trading card features Teddy Bridgewater, the Louisville Cardinals' football star. With its base set design, this sports trading card is a must-have for any fan of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). The card number is 17 and it's from the 2021 season. 

The card is manufactured by Panini and it's a type of sports trading card. It's not autographed and it's a part of the 2021 Panini Contenders Draft Picks set. This card is perfect for collectors who are looking to add a piece of Louisville Cardinals' history to their collection.
